frozen_formal_obligations.name: matrix_power_correct
frozen_formal_obligations.statement: For every semiring R, finite square matrix M, and k, the generic MonoidData compilePower adapter equals the genuine Mathlib matrix power M^k.

frozen_formal_obligations.name: scalar_compiler_correct
frozen_formal_obligations.statement: The explicit scalar circuit using shared matrix steps, elementary scalar additions/multiplications, and input wiring evaluates to sum_i u_i * sum_j (M^k)_ij * v_j for arbitrary semiring inputs.

frozen_formal_obligations.name: dense_product_gate_count
frozen_formal_obligations.statement: For r>=1, the elementary scalar gate count of the constructed dense matrix product circuit is 2*r^3-r^2.

frozen_formal_obligations.name: conditional_scalar_budget
frozen_formal_obligations.statement: For r>=1,n>=2 and supplied input construction cost S, the constructed scalar circuit at k=n^n-1 plus S costs at most S+4*r^3*n^2+3*r^2.

formal_metric: Kernel-verified obligations with no sorry or added axioms divided by 4. All declarations audited; incomplete/probe sources score zero.

python_protocol.dimensions: r=n only; optional r=n^2 not part of this metric
python_protocol.input_leaves: One explicit leaf for every M_ij, u_i, v_i. No target answer supplied. Free zero/one constants are allowed leaves.
python_protocol.u_v: Explicit small integer vectors from indices; no answer-dependent initialization
python_protocol.semantic_oracle: Independent iterative matrix-vector update repeated k times, then a scalar dot product; exact integer arithmetic
python_protocol.gate_checks: Serialized topological scalar SSA graph; count actual add and mul nodes and reject forward references. Compare with the complete dense multiplication/contraction count formula.
python_protocol.exports: A full DAG for each n; evaluation agreement for all three cases. Input graphs shared across cases.
python_protocol.metric: 12 exact evaluation agreements plus 4 graph/topology/count checks; this finite score is reported separately from formal score

scope: Conditional compiler ingredient. No assertion that a polynomial-dimensional target representation or polynomial-cost initial data exists.
